SELECT
FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.username}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.username}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.username}, '%'))
AND u.user_type = #{q.userType}
AND u.status = #{q.status}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} )
ORDER BY u.id ASC

SELECT ur.user_id AS userId, r.id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id IN #{uid} ORDER BY r.sort ASC
SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.sort ASC
SELECT r.id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 1 AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != ''

SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY FIELD(r.role_code, 'ADMIN', 'ACADEMIC', 'HEAD_TEACHER', 'STUDENT'), r.sort ASC LIMIT 1
